summary.title: INTERIØRSENTERET TRØNDELAG AS

narrative.text: INTERIØRSENTERET TRØNDELAG AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Detaljhandel med innredningsartikler ikke nevnt annet sted", registered 1999-10-19.
Its own website describes it as: "Ta kontakt med oss i dag for å booke gratis tegnetime, befaring eller for øvrige henvendelser."
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 18.2 million and an annual result of NOK -1.4 million.
Registered leadership: Tor Olsen (Daglig leder); Arnfinn Magne Falstad (Styrets leder).
Head office in Verdal, with 3 registered workplaces.
Verified website: https://interiorsenteret.no/; it links to facebook, instagram, pinterest profiles.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: group, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.

revenue_comparison.derivation: absolute_change = latest_revenue - previous_revenue; percent_change = absolute_change / previous_revenue * 100 (only when previous_revenue > 0)

summary.revenue_comparison_text: Revenue was NOK 18.2 million in 2025, down from NOK 24.7 million in 2024, a decrease of NOK 6.5 million (26.4%).
